For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一群自称为改革派的人。
